title: PRIMETIME
synopsis:
Based on real events, the film follows news anchor Chris Hansen (Pattinson) and his team as they pioneer a radical new format: posing as underage teens in online chat rooms, they lure suspected child predators to a suburban home wired with hidden cameras. When the unsuspecting targets walk into the trap, Hansen bursts in with a camera crew and a police escort to confront them on the spot — all for live television.
The formula is explosive. Ratings soar. But the deeper Chris and his crew fall into the pursuit of viewers, fame, and "justice," the harder it becomes to tell where journalism ends and vigilantism begins — until the sting operations themselves spiral into a vortex they can no longer control.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 《實境誘捕》講述新聞節目主持人 Chris Hansen（羅拔柏迪臣 飾）與製作團隊構思了一項前所未有的「實境誘捕新聞節目」：團隊成員在網絡聊天室假扮未成年少男少女，透過對話吸引專門於網上誘騙兒童的疑犯，前往早已裝設隱藏鏡頭的住宅赴約。當這些心懷不軌的目標一步步踏入精心設下的陷阱時，Chris 便會帶着攝影機突襲現身與那些疑犯現場對質，並配合警方進行即場逮捕。隨著節目收視率一飛沖天，Chris 與團隊在收視名利、新聞倫理及私刑正義之間的界線逐漸變得模糊，誘捕行動也逐步走入失控的道德與犯罪漩渦之中……

cast: Robert Pattinson, Merritt Wever, Skyler Gisondo, Phoebe Bridgers, Anna Faris, Tony Revolori
